Sir Rockman, the indomitable Knight of Mello

Created by the engineer Ebuc, lost to the hatch. He was programed for defense, to strengthen the town. His soul had begun to resonate with a fellow colonist named Leaf, the nature cleric. After some brave advice from Wren, he decided to ask for her hand. He married Leaf at the château-de-léclipse. After events had unfolded, leading to the theft of 3 artifact and the baby god Mello herself, Rockman had become stricken with grief and remorse for his actions. Even though at the time he did not know that he was the one that had done the deed himself, he pleaded for mercy and forgiveness to the Deity Mello. Looking to his wife Leaf, he begged to be taken in under Mello's protection. Not knowing religion in the past week of his life's existence, he pledged himself to Mello in his wife's presence. His plea was heard, and sir Rockman the artificer had been mentally teleported to Mello's own realm. He laughed and played with a small girl in a field of flowers, his childlike soul refreshing his purity. Mello then gave him a choice, with a pinky-promise. The decision was made with his wife's faith to this deity in mind rather quickly. Mello had accepted his patronage and made him a paladin of her order. A protector of his wife and their faith.
